content:
maria_cs: Fern from BrightBridge reports repeated 429s only during onboarding spike when they rotated to our quickstart SDK. They said the failures stop after ~90s. Can SDK/infra triage?

 fern_support: Context: they run 60 containers, each performs a few /chat completions immediately after startup to validate prompts. They see many 429s clustered at t+10s after deployment. Excerpt: 

 fern_support: ```
2026-05-02T11:20:10Z INFO SDK init done
2026-05-02T11:20:10Z WARN response 429 limit_exceeded
2026-05-02T11:20:10Z INFO Retrying attempt=1 delay=0ms
2026-05-02T11:20:10Z WARN response 429 limit_exceeded
2026-05-02T11:20:11Z ERROR pool: connection reset
```

 dan_sdk: Which SDK version? Any custom retry settings?

 maria_cs: They used quickstart bundle with sdk-go v1.8.0 and left defaults.

 dan_sdk: v1.8.0 has prefetch/concurrency defaults that can cause multiple simultaneous requests; also our old default retry strategy retried immediately for some transient errors. We've updated defaults in v1.9.0 to include jitter.

 raj_sre: From gateway logs we see a sharp burst from the same API key with lots of new TCP connections. That triggers our adaptive limiter that returns 429s; it self-recovers after short window, explaining ~90s tail.

 claire_prod: Is there an onboarding checklist or guidance we can send customers to prevent this?

 fern_support: Short-term mitigation we recommend to customers: add a randomized warmup delay across hosts and enable HTTP keepalive. Sample snippet we give: 

 fern_support: ```go
// simple jittered warmup
rand.Seed(time.Now().UnixNano())
wait := time.Duration(rand.Intn(800)) * time.Millisecond
time.Sleep(wait)
client.Embed(ctx, payload)
// and set client config
client.Config.MaxConnsPerHost = 10
client.Config.KeepAlive = true
```

 dan_sdk: We'll also backport a runtime check in SDK to detect rapid retry loops and insert small jitter if running in quickstart mode. Patch planned for v1.9.1.

 raj_sre: Server side we can add a temporary onboarding grace window: for new keys seen in the last N minutes, throttle less aggressively for the first M seconds. We can roll this as a feature-flagged canary.

 deploybot: Scheduled canary: 2026-05-02T13:00:00 UTC. sdkgateway: onboarding-grace-feature-flag enabled on 5% hosts.

 maria_cs: Action items: (1) Fern to add jitter + keepalive and retest (ETA 45m). (2) Dan to prepare SDK patch to guard quickstart warmups (ETA PR by EOD). (3) Raj to canary onboarding-grace flag (ETA 13:00 UTC). (4) KB: add warmup checklist (Fern/ Maria).

 fern_support: Update: After adding 0-800ms jitter and enabling keepalive, observed 1-2 429s during startup across fleet, no cascade. Stable now.

 maria_cs: Great, please post reproduction steps in KB so new customers get the guidance early.

 kb_bot: New KB created: "Avoiding onboarding spikes: jitter, keepalive, and SDK defaults" https://kb.redwood.ai/articles/2026/onboarding-spike-mitigation

 dan_sdk: Note to self: update quickstart templates to v1.9.1 when released and include jitter helper by default.

 maria_cs: Closing thread. Reopen if the canary roll shows any regressions. :white_check_mark:
